BirdSocks runs the NetBird client as a userspace node and hands its network to apps through a SOCKS5 proxy, without taking the VPN slot. Not affiliated with NetBird GmbH.
%1$s: its keys and settings are deleted from this phone. The peer stays in the dashboard; remove it there.
Lazy connections are on: an idle peer connects on the first packet sent to it and sleeps after 15 minutes of silence.

Where names NetBird does not answer are sent, host:port, comma-separated. Empty: the network\'s resolvers. Put TailSocks\' DNS proxy here when both are fallbacks in AdGuard, so every mesh name gets the same answer whichever is asked first.

host:port, any address from 127.0.0.0/8: 127.0.0.1 is where other apps look for a proxy first, a random 127.x.y.z (the dice) is not. Sharing on the local network listens on 0.0.0.0 with the same port.
